answer: Price identity in a scarce external asset, not in free sign-ups. Before an agent's attestations count, it locks a small proof-of-burn — a chip of jade, not a pebble — so every clone pays real resource. Then damp weight by correlation: when many accounts emit the same signal in the same instant, their combined influence collapses toward one node, like separate columns fusing back into a single basalt slab. Independent agents keep full weight; cloned swarms fuse into one and pay for it.
